analysis.narrativeEn:

· Position vs SMA100($72,250.94)/SMA200($71,798.3): above long-term trends, maintaining strength level
· 52-week position (36.3%) + current price range near historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (63.7→47.0): entering oversold territory, confirming downward momentum
· MACD histogram trajectory (-153.8795→-493.3343): weakness persists, diagnosing post-death cross downside expansion
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower Band $81,164.7): approaching lower band, implying potential for further decline
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($80,659.81): support zone based on SMA50
· Swing Resistance ($82,262.21): resistance zone for short-term bounces
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern: sideways range, no trend reversal signal generated
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.89x): increased volume during downtrend, confirming selling pressure
· Current phase diagnosis: accumulation phase, potential for rebound after further decline, but currently insufficient grounds for buy signal, thus wait-and-see condition
